summary: WorkPlan initial-reservation is checkable at standard density: five property-level Gherkin items (W1–W5) map 1:1 to requirements/reservation.feature Scenarios and cover all Brief in_scope R1–R7 and success_criteria SC1–SC6; no out_of_scope X* ids appear in covers or tags; each acceptance_criterion is Given/When/Then with named domain errors where required; depends_on empty (no cycles). Lint pass with only minors: Brief R1 ‘sufficient’ ambiguity (clarified by Feature “at least the requested quantity” and R2/SC2) and pairwise overlapping touches on shared OpenAPI/OCL/src paths—serialize advisory only, not a checkability hole. W3’s single Scenario for unauthorized reserve or release matches Brief R3/SC3 as one property.
